pages.title: Carried by the config
pages.content:
# Carried by the config

This page has no file. Its markdown is a string in the manifest itself,
which is what an API doc behind a login needs: the prose travels with the
config its backend already generates.

> [!NOTE]
> Everything else is unchanged — callouts, anchors, the table of contents,
> the search index and the `llms-full.txt` export all read it like any other
> page.

## The other way round

When the config is written by hand rather than generated, `contentId` points
at a `<script type="text/markdown">` in the host page instead — see the dev
index page for that form.
